_comment: Made By FALCREB. Plugins and tools that install.py sets up. Versions of npm tools are pinned so every machine gets the same one; bump them on purpose, never to 'latest' blindly.

marketplaces.name: claude-plugins-official
marketplaces.note: Anthropic's official plugin catalog (auto-updates by default)

marketplaces.name: anthropic-agent-skills
marketplaces.note: Anthropic's skills catalog. Added as a catalog only: the document skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) already come with a claude.ai account

plugins.note: Asks what you really want, writes a plan, then builds it test-first
Up-to-date library documentation, so Claude does not write outdated code
Lets Claude open your site or app in a browser and test it (needs Node.js)
Security warnings while Claude edits code, plus an AI review on code-changing turns and commits (uses extra quota)

npm_tools.note: Fallback when a project has no TypeScript of its own. Check language server support before moving to 7.x
